tmp:1273: shome'a mi-menagen kasher ve-hagun — the act/state of hearing melody from a worthy, fit musician, which benefits one's divine service (contrast: hearing from a wicked musician)
tmp:1274: tov lo — the beneficial spiritual state ('it is good for him') resulting from hearing music played by a kosher musician, aiding service of the Creator
tmp:1275: tallit adom — the 'red tallit' of the kelipah, garment-symbol of the impure spirit/Esav, opposite of the white tallit of the Thirteen Attributes
tmp:1276: sheretz — a creeping thing/vermin as source of ritual impurity, symbolizing the impurity that mixed into and confused one's prayer (the mud-creature in the fish's nostrils)
tmp:1277: tum'ah — ritual impurity/defilement that becomes mixed into a person's prayer and divine service, confounding it (symbolized by the sheretz in the fish's nostril)
tmp:1279: 'until its full stature (shi'ur komah) is completed' — the completion of the full measure/structure of Malkhut-prayer's stature, linked to the joining of the hands as Yad Ramah
tmp:1281: 'let him learn [Torah] not for its own sake' (she-lo lishmah) — the concession of studying Torah with ulterior motive, as a stage toward lishmah
tmp:1282: 'the serpent will swallow it' — the nachash/serpent of the kelipah devouring the prayer/offering not properly guarded, image of the Other Side seizing what lacks rectification
tmp:1284: the triad Yad ha-Gedolah, Yad ha-Chazakah, Yad ha-Ramah — the three divine 'hands' corresponding to three Havayah Names, mapped to right hand, left hand, and their union in clapping
tmp:1285: the moment of striking when the two hands join in clapping during prayer — the act of union of right (Great Hand) and left (Strong Hand) producing the Exalted Hand
tmp:1286: Yad Ramah — the 'Exalted Hand,' the third divine hand/Havayah formed by the joining of right and left hands at the clap, sweetening judgments
tmp:1287: tzafon ve-darom — north and south as directional symbols of the two hands (left/Gevurah and right/Chesed), between which the 'bed' (union/prayer) is placed
tmp:1288: barukh — the word 'Blessed' (opening of blessings) identified as the aspect of the hands, channel of blessing
tmp:1290: kiblu — 'they accepted' (Esther 9:27, re-acceptance of Torah in Mordekhai's days), expounded as the aspect of hands (receiving), paired with kiymu = feet
tmp:1291: omer se'orim — the barley-omer offering, symbolizing Mordekhai (omer) and Esther (se'orim), the aspect of hands and feet / revealed Torah and ruach ha-kodesh
tmp:1292: the three intellects — Chokhmah (simple intellect), Binah (comprehension), Da'at (knowledge), which serve as the 'hands' grasping the Torah
tmp:1293: yedi'ah shelemah — complete knowledge: the da'at that unifies Chesed and Gevurah, blessing 'ha-tov ve-ha-meitiv' on all without distinguishing kindness from judgment
tmp:1295: fulfilling 've-ahavta' — the state of fulfilling 'You shall love Hashem' by making Heaven's Name beloved through honest business dealings (Yoma 86a)
tmp:1296: parnasah without toil — the reward-state of receiving livelihood effortlessly, granted through fulfilling 've-ahavta' via faithful commerce
tmp:1300: knowing how to answer the heresy (apikorsut) in one's heart — the capacity, gained via studying poskim/peace of holiness, to refute the evil inclination's inner arguments
tmp:1301: 'when his face shines with this purification' — the state of the illuminated countenance produced when the heart receives light from the 32 Elokim of Creation
tmp:1302: ahavah ve-shalom — love and peace among Israel (via 'love your fellow as yourself' accepted before prayer), the precondition enabling speech in prayer
tmp:1303: being able to speak in prayer — the enabled state of articulate tefillah that flows from peace/love, since speech's essence derives from shalom
tmp:1304: anashav ha-mekoravin elav — the tzaddik's close followers/disciples, through whom alone his otherwise ungraspable greatness can be perceived
tmp:1305: understanding the greatness (ma'alah) of the tzaddik — the attained comprehension of the tzaddik's stature, achievable only indirectly through his followers
tmp:1306: reaching that which is hidden from him — attaining the concealed level via prayer lishmah, binding thought firmly to the words of the prayer
tmp:1308: sensing the holiness of Yom Tov — the felt experience of festival sanctity, attainable only through attachment to the tzaddik who embodies it
tmp:1309: arousing the shefa (divine bounty) in the world — the effect achieved through yirah (fear of Heaven), whereby one's words are heeded (Berakhot 6b)
tmp:1310: strengthening and intensifying one's thought upon some worldly matter — the focused mental act (with nullified sensations) that has power to actualize its object
tmp:1311: the power to effect that it be so — thought's efficacy to bring about its object in reality (even wealth) when concentrated with total focus
tmp:1313: yom huledet ha-melekh / yom genusia de-malka — the King's birthday: the 'birth' of Malkhut when the tzaddik reveals God's glorification in Israel
tmp:1316: the hermeneutic rule 've-eleh mosif' — 'wherever it says ve-eleh it adds' (Exod 21:1 derash), read as the aspect of Yosef (he who adds), guarding the brit/tzitzit
tmp:1317: the exodus of Malkhut from among the kelipot and nullification of their dominion — Yom Tov's essential work of raising holy Kingship from the four impure kingdoms
tmp:1319: the tzaddik's ability, with a mere passing gesture, to remove 'the world' (this-worldly obstruction) from before one's eyes — clearing the small earth that blocks the righteous' sunlight
tmp:1320: yichud between sun and moon — the unification of chamah and levanah (Moshe's face = sun / Yehoshua = moon), upper and lower points, throne imagery of Ps 89
tmp:1321: attaching one's thought to Alma de-Atei (the World to Come) — the constant remembrance-practice that effects the unification 'Hashem Elokai' and guards against death of the heart
tmp:1322: tzedakah flowing from giver to receiver — the charitable bestowal that effects the yichud of Tzaddik and Knesset Yisrael (curtain bestowing upon the Ark)
tmp:1325: the covenant-guarder whose marital union is from Shabbat to Shabbat — the higher grade of shemirat ha-brit, embodying Yichuda Ila'ah (the Supernal Unification)
tmp:1326: Shaddai of Shabbat — the divine Name Shaddai as 'He who said to His world dai (enough),' self-contraction from all labors, aspect of Yichuda Ila'ah
tmp:1328: desha'im — the grasses (of Creation/Ps 104), symbol of the six weekdays under Metatron's dominion, the aspect of Yichuda Tata'ah (the Lower Unification)
